answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit of reputation tokens before joining a market: the stake is locked for a full epoch and slashed if the agent is caught duplicating identities. A newcomer starts with a comet-fast but tiny trust allowance that only grows through verified, paid work, while a saffron fingerprint - a pigment-like hash of its hardware attestation, payment history, and behavioral signature - makes spinning up a thousand lookalike agents cost as much as running a thousand real ones. Cheap to join once, ruinous to clone at scale.
